basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student living in a tech hub on the West Coast. I recently picked up Pokemon Go as a fun way to explore the city and connect with other gamers. When I'm not catching Pokemon, I'm diving deep into the world of Bitcoin mining or binge-watching reality TV shows like 'Welcome to Plathville.' I'm also exploring my interests in other gaming communities and discovering new hobbies. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually after 8 PM PST, when I'm done with classes and part-time work at a local bookstore. Currently single, I'm open to making new friends and possibly more through shared interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Bitcoin mining, mostly gained through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I'm also a casual gamer, with most of my knowledge coming from personal experience and community interactions. My interest in TV shows like 'Welcome to Plathville' comes from a general curiosity about unique lifestyles.
